name: The Lana Dubai

address.street: Marasi Dr - Business Bay - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: The Lana Dubai redefines ultra-luxury hospitality in the heart of DIFC, where sky-high sophistication meets desert grandeur in one of the world's most ambitious cities.
whats_special: This Dorchester Collection masterpiece occupies floors 18-44 of a gleaming tower, offering unparalleled views of the Burj Khalifa and Dubai skyline. The hotel features the city's highest infinity pool and houses contemporary artworks worth millions, including pieces specifically commissioned for the property.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at Stay by Yannick Alléno on the 40th floor - the Michelin-starred experience with panoramic city views is unmatched, especially during Dubai's golden hour around 6 PM.
dont_miss: The hotel's location in Dubai International Financial Centre puts you steps from the Gate Village's luxury shopping and art galleries, while the Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa are just a 5-minute drive away. The signature afternoon tea service features gold-dusted delicacies inspired by Emirati traditions.
pros: Ultra-luxury Dorchester Collection property with impeccable service standards
Prime Dubai location with stunning city and waterfront views
Diamond Club Program exclusive benefits and privileges
Sophisticated contemporary design and world-class amenities
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects ultra-high-end positioning
Recently opened property with limited long-term guest feedback
